notes.title: New Hacking Tasks, Black Market Loot & Tutorial
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
This update is the penultimate update before the 1.0 release and includes a completely revamped tutorial, new hacking tasks and more Black Market loot.

[h3]New Tutorial[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Most of you probably won't need it anymore, but there are still some new players joining Midnight Heist who received an outdated tutorial after the major gameplay overhaul. We have completely redesigned the entire tutorial and made each individual task available in a training area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f09f62c617e41417adc1a4f2fc170327505616ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/c716c281b7eb00b7437e2459b61e80b18cdfcf9a.jpg[/img]

[h3]More variations[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
To keep hacking fun, we've added 6 more mini-games that will require skill or logic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8ef9b00bbfda3ae664827dad5bf8aa69a58072ca.png[/img]

At the same time, we have also made it our mission to add new Black Market items with this update. Each of these items comes with the usual three rarity levels and has its own value limits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/31328dc5362dcd2b491492fe6ae70f92e544a08c.png[/img]

[h3]Bugs fixed[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]The daily challenge no longer overrides your progress, but increases it
[*]Fixed snow & rain going through the walls of Cemax Agency South
[/list]

[h3]Upcoming release of Midnight Heist[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
This update is a little smaller than usual, as we are now focusing 100% on the release of Midnight Heist in October. The release will come with a major update, the contents of which you can see in our roadmap. We will announce the exact release date soon.

We will also need testers before the release and are grateful for any help in the run-up to the release to ensure that everything runs as smoothly as possible. We will also be focusing heavily on marketing so that we can attract lots of new players who will decide the future of Midnight Heist.

If you are not yet on our Discord server, you are welcome to join. Feel free to exchange experiences with the community or send us feedback and ideas. Please follow the link below:

Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Operation Chimera, Leaderboard, Missions & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Our major content update 0.9 is finally ready and brings a completely new operation, a rework of the existing operation, a new organization mission system and a leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/38106fee304079955424a63da7849b612a3c9112.png[/img]

[h3]Overhaul of the Operations[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Previously, we offered story content in the form of text that explained the events in Midnight City. With the new system, we have visual and audio changes that not only make the events in Midnight City more immersive, but also draw you completely into the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/45d2fc334030d33045fe0e1cd3917d2dbdca6479.jpg[/img]

Both the first Operation Interceptio and the new Operation Chimera have been fully dubbed and feature video effects. We therefore strongly recommend that you revisit the first operation (even if you have already completed it).

[h3]Operation Chimera[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
With the new Operation Chimera, we are offering 34 new missions that come with even more rewards and special skins—but with the big change that the events and stories in this operation are faster-paced, more thrilling, and more exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/61d25490434335ce7c5c971491e3c9b36b8d45a5.jpg[/img]

In addition, we recommend that you read the background stories of the individual characters via the small icon in the operation next to the globe, if you haven't already done so. These contain important key elements that will make your journey through the operation even more exciting and amazing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/7f4f856ec37ef471e0888a51f01ed1e783fa546c.jpg[/img]

Besides the normal characters, Operation Chimera also features a narrator who explains and reads out important documents that you can collect and view. These contain important research data on the entities, for example, allowing you to delve deep into the events and feel like you are right there in the thick of the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/87e0524cff14669bfb949155827188af59da82ac.jpg[/img]

[h3]Organization Missions[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/3fca68716261bd957578c760a42387bc656ff49a.jpg[/img]

Another major new feature is the new organization mission system. This offers randomly generated missions with randomly generated rewards of varying sizes and rarity levels. You can select one mission at a time or reroll the missions in exchange for data. The special feature here is that there are missions for the three organizations we know. After completing a mission, you level up the organization to receive permanent rewards:

[list]
[*] Satoshi give you a cash bonus after every heist
[*] Black Hats increase the value of Black Market items in your inventory
[*] Shadow increases the amount of XP received
[/list]

The maximum level for each organization is 50, so you can spend a lot of time upgrading your bonuses.

[h3]The Leaderboard[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In your hideout, right next to the whiteboard, you will find a screen that displays valuable data about all hackers and thieves in Midnight City. After each heist, the looted money is automatically scanned by the new tracking system and uploaded to the global network in Midnight City. On the screen, you can view the global or local (friends) leaderboard and compare yourself to hackers and thieves from all over Midnight City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/316f2e64be9f5d148b9e86d72d348bd0bb807f9d.jpg[/img]

Who will make it to the top?

[h3]Upcoming release of Midnight Heist[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As already announced in our roadmap, the 1.0 release of Midnight Heist is coming soon. We still have version 0.9.5 to look forward to, with more content for existing systems, and the big 1.0 update, in which we have lots of new content in store for you, bringing a breath of fresh air to Midnight Heist. We will probably reset the leaderboard for the release, or at least design it so that there is a new leaderboard for the release (so that the old one is replaced but not deleted).

We are very excited to see how you like this update and, as always, eagerly await your feedback!

If you are not yet on our Discord server, you are welcome to join. Feel free to exchange experiences with the community or send us feedback and ideas. Please follow the link below:

[url=https://discord.gg/Ddy3ua6PC5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8c295700f3b1bd20a5114e4f09de344b3aadf52f.png[/img][/url]

Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: New Map & Security System
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
Apologies for the slight delay, we actually wanted to have uploaded the update back in June, but the new map and testing took a lot of time again. We also adjusted the new alarm system several times until we were happy with it - but in the end, it's your feedback that counts the most!

[h3]New Map[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The new map is the hideout of the Crimsons, another criminal organization, which is a bunker-like building with many vertical movement options and an open design, unlike the previous bunker map with new freedom of movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/75023a4ba6398388453dd66768f42ea9a73f4bb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/496e7e8e4bb720ab363501ac3bfd1578726b820f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/a75815f2a49e715544d0c811760d9fc194b68420.png[/img]

[h3]Security System[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We were thinking about making the cameras more important and came up with an idea: You can now be caught by the cameras!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/16a12c18f8e0fac11c499d09960efc31a9b5eda1.gif[/img]

As soon as you have been caught by a camera, you have a few seconds to disappear from the field of view again, otherwise you will be registered by the system. If you are caught once, the entire team receives a 25% penalty on the total loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/c23e38d83ffeffe35cfab6748af7abc2ae97b133.jpg[/img]

To reduce this penalty to 10%, you can hack the server in the server room. A new optional task will also appear once you have been caught.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]We have improved the save system so that there can hopefully no longer be corrupted save files.[/*][/list]

The next update in August will include lots of story content and the new whiteboard mission system. Get ready for a big content update and keep giving us feedback on existing systems!

notes.title: Afterlife & Equipment Upgrades
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We are well on schedule with our new roadmap and have the long-awaited afterlife and equipment upgrade update ready!

[h3]After Life[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
A big problem with Midnight Heist in co-op was that when you died, you didn't really have anything to do. We've addressed this problem with the Afterlife update, so now there's a lot to do when you're a ghost.

As a ghost, you now have the opportunity to increase the maximum loot for the rest of the survivors by completing mini-games and solve a big puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/463f8b790298d9e121d7447923399d24c72d9765.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/dcbc3b47f7136340356bcc0f8f7d031087464e14.gif[/img]

Both completing mini-games and completing the puzzle ensure that new loot appears for the survivors to collect. In addition, as a ghost you can now mark any item (if it makes sense) so that the people alive can see it for a maximum of 30 seconds. A maximum of 3 items can be marked at the same time.

However, if you don't want to help your team, but rather scare them, there is now also the option of imitating the sounds of an entity as a ghost.

[h3]Equipment Upgrades[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In the item overview, you will now find upgrades for each item that optimize this item with features or improvements just for you. These range from increased range and brightness of the flashlight to completely new functions such as placing the EMP grenade as a trap. These upgrades are permanent and have a certain level as a requirement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/c81651391683016e1d1caa4f15ffdc19dd1263c3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4cbdd80d3e697df4839648dab6e4ed52fedd0c5d.gif[/img]

[b]+1 new item slot[/b]
We have also listened to your feedback and are now allowing a total of 5 items to be used at the same time, instead of 4 as before.

[b]Important:[/b] [i]With this update, the additional functions of the flashlight (UV light) and the smartphone (camera) have become independent upgrades for unlocking.[/i]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where hacked cams displayed the wrong floor
[*] Fixed a bug where used EMPs would not be removed from the loadout
[*] Fixed a bug where highlighted loot with the “Sharp Sighted” perk was still active when the player died near it

notes.title: New Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Please take a few minutes to read this announcement as you, our players and our community, have a big part to play in this.

You know us as very transparent and reliable developers who stick to their word and always put the community's feedback first. This has not changed since the release of Midnight Heist in October 2023 and will not change. This is precisely why we would like to communicate openly and honestly with you about our economic situation and the resulting changes - with the request for your permission.

[h3]What is the current situation?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
For the release of Midnight Heist we have published a roadmap with content that we have planned until the 1.0 release. Here you can see this roadmap with the things we have already implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8116584a05c3903b72715afc19b05ce61c38b00e.png[/img]

In addition, there are features that were not planned but have made it into the game thanks to community feedback, such as the Black Market missions, the modules and the latest Horror 2.0 update.

So far so good, but Midnight Heist has had a problem for some time - the number of players.

Out of 264 reviews, Midnight Heist has a 93% positive rating.
This makes us incredibly happy and is indeed no small success, but the many positive reviews themselves highlight the problem.

[i]“I cant believe this game has such a low player count”
“This game needs more attention from social media”
“Why are there no players?”
“The only issue is that the playerbase is very low”[/i]

Despite the many positive reviews, the current economic situation of Midnight Heist is unfortunately not good. Sales are falling, despite great interest and very positive feedback.

Because we want to be so transparent and open, we want to let you know that the current economic situation is difficult for us. As a team of two people, we still have a few resources to make it to the 1.0 release, but we have decided to change the roadmap a little.

[h3]The new roadmap and the request for your permission[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Basically there wasn't much missing from the previous roadmap, but after several hours of planning we sat down and decided to create a new roadmap with concrete ideas for content up to the 1.0 release. We want to move the “nice to have” features out and make them dependent on the release success of Midnight Heist and focus on what we think are more fun and necessary systems and improvements until the full release. The new roadmap would therefore look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/fe8a2c05ea84f3b38aa3c201798b54d1f84baa26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/24c539b856528e4a9831b8ce41606ee960a51628.png[/img]

But because we don't want to simply change the roadmap, even though Early Access can bring radical changes, we would like to ask you as our community for permission to continue with this new roadmap.

We still have a lot of ideas for Midnight Heist and will support our first co-op title as much as we can economically, but as a small company we have to be very careful not to let our ambitions ruin us.

[h3]What is the plan now?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
With the new roadmap, we are aiming for a full release for Midnight Heist this year, along with a huge marketing campaign to somehow save Midnight Heist.

We would like to make all further ideas and content that we had planned dependent on the success of the 1.0 release. This is the best economic decision we can make in order to continue developing games and thus continue our passion.

Rest assured, we will do everything in our power to continue developing great content for Midnight Heist for as long as we can!

[h3]Thank you[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Finally, we would like to thank you again for the amazing support we have received from you so far. On Steam, as well as on Discord and other platforms, we are very happy to have built such a community together with you. 

We are more ambitious than ever before and will give our all, you can count on that!

If you have any questions or comments, please write to us either as a comment on this post, in the Steam discussions, on Discord or simply on a platform of your choice where we are represented.

[hr][/hr]
If you are not yet on our Discord server, you are welcome to join. Feel free to exchange experiences with the community or send us feedback and ideas. Please follow the link below:

[url=https://discord.gg/Ddy3ua6PC5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8c295700f3b1bd20a5114e4f09de344b3aadf52f.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/Ddy3ua6PC5]Join our community Discord server[/url]

See you in Midnight City,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Horror 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/b6599c7d57fc676fd3108ae94420ad90d8dedcf2.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We are delighted to announce that we are finally finished with the major Horror 2.0 expansion and, above all, the overhaul. This update makes the gameplay and the horror even more dynamic.

[h3]Sanity[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Let's start with sanity first. As you know, we had already implemented a sanity mechanic since the beginning, but never displayed it properly. Now you can see an overview of each player's sanity on the van.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/717119a2d5dce2951fb48eb3e5fb75f28b61af68.jpg[/img]

We have reworked the horror system so that horror events are now largely responsible for lowering your Sanity. So if you see or hear a lot of paranormal things, your Sanity will drop faster. In addition, you will lose less/slower Sanity when you are in the light.

[h3]Improvements to the entities[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have revised and improved the AI and the way the Entities hunt. The entities can now hear your microphones and react to them. They also look at the player they are currently targeting or chasing and have new spawn and despawn animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/ac2964287b2d4bae5be408cd332096af178fef9e.gif[/img]

We've made a UI improvement to the mechanic that lets entities hear your microphones. Now you can see how loud you are when you talk in your audio meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/acd709bb72abe2efeeb8b919a24a4cad5db01ae3.gif[/img]

[h3]New way of hunting[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Entities no longer make a loud noise when they spawn, but they search more slowly. They can only hunt “properly” when the new midnight bells sound. This tells you that things are getting serious. Entities can now search rooms independently and look around before making their next move. Basically, hunting is now more unpredictable, but just as fair, as the search speed has been adjusted. Entities only really start running when they have seen or heard something. This means that there is always an opportunity to sneak away or look for a new hiding place.

[h3]Destructible hiding places[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Yes, you read that absolutely right! The lockers you always hide in can now be destroyed by the Entities. Each locker has 3 lives. If an Entity catches you in a locker (and sometimes randomly if it feels like it), it will hit it and damage the metal. After the third hit, the door will be destroyed and you will be pulled out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/c44ad41abfcdea5c291e9dc1336deedffb3d2f3e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/e734d4441957cf70c849e02f12913e559a65e84f.jpg[/img]

[h3]New horror events[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We are particularly proud of the new horror events. Now the entities are basically omnipresent. That means you'll hear or see something all the time. There are completely new unpredictable fake hunts that can pop up and scare you at any time. Entities can also now crawl on the ceiling if they want to drive you mad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/b987487db355e944301ce064d4ba280bf963ca26.png[/img]

[h3]New entity[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have expanded our Entities with Yukio, our latest Entity. A floating entity which is very quiet and doesn't make any noise when it sees you. So be on your guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8a0513ad194965ae7aed766aec2c4379391959a2.gif[/img]

[h3]New consumable equipment[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Sanity Pills[/b]
We have now added Sanity Pills that restore 25% of your Sanity each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/c8c3465e7e4670c2698702046884dc2ae44170d9.gif[/img]

[b]EMP grenade[/b]
With the new EMP grenades, we finally have the chance to defend ourselves against the Entities for the first time. These stun every Entity within explosion range for 5 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0905f03f909bfda45fd1c1623cd279cb678e9da0.gif[/img]

[h3]New difficulty level[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have added a new difficulty level “Insane”, which is the newest, highest difficulty level. It now brings a total of 75% more EXP and rewards, but has all the properties of Nightmare with even faster entities and the biggest change: The entities can spawn EVERYWHERE, as in the first version of Midnight Heist, without fixed spawn points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/d73593d55ad40f176210dd7fe5f224a00ff5fc01.jpg[/img]

[h3]Further changes and adjustments[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We've also fixed a few bugs and made some changes to make your life in Midnight City a little easier. Even though the Horror 2.0 update has now been released, we will continue to make improvements, also thanks to your feedback.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed ghosts blocking each other
[*] Fixed a bug where the entity Ragnok could not hear the player
[*] Fixed a case where the ghost could lock players inside a room with no chance to escape. Now the ghost will only lock doors if there is a chance to escape
[*] Fixed a bug where you could pick up too many items with certain perks selected

notes.title: New Gameplay & Equipment!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We're celebrating our first anniversary of Midnight Heist and have a new update for you!

Just in time for the spookiest time of the year, we have brought you a big gameplay update. This update is part 1 of a total of 2, as some things didn't make it due to time constraints. Nevertheless, we have developed a lot of new gameplay features and even unlocked the equipment with this update. Let's start with this one right away!

[h3]Equipment[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/2f689e643df57d0f8fe0930d4f9b1f42b0bfb296.png[/img]
There are now a total of 9 individual items with their own functions, with more to come in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/dbbe0406608d38afac4c4031fcabccca796577cf.jpg[/img]

In addition to your perks and modules on the tablet, you will now also see a new menu called “Equipment” on the workbench. Here you can equip yourself with items for your heists, at least one of which is always included so that you are able to complete the new tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/41344584e327f2b4471185a5aec5bcc8ac971339.jpg[/img]

What you currently have equipped for the upcoming heist is displayed in the mission overview as “Loadout”. Every player is able to buy and add items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f1f79c5ff422894f45e7e0cc14e54032900caaa7.jpg[/img]

All the equipment you have added to your arsenal for the heist can be seen in the new redesigned van at the start. Along with this come two tables on which all your available equipment for this heist is placed, which you can switch back and forth at any time.

It is now possible to carry 4 items at the same time, of which the smartphone is always equipped by default. By default you can also use the “G” button to drop equipped items, for example to pick up other items.

[h3]Objectives[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In addition to the main objective of hacking computers, there are now additional, randomly selected main tasks each round, which are displayed in your mission overview.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f36a6b56f8808162b1193ef25477e73c62dc6ec1.jpg[/img]

For the new tasks, we have always written instructions on how to complete these tasks. Depending on the number of players, an additional main task will be added for each additional player. The rest are optional bonus tasks.

Each task requires a specific item to solve it, sometimes even several. It is therefore advisable to look at the tasks in advance to know what you need. Each additional task will bring a fixed reward of €500!

At this point, it might seem like a step back in terms of item functionality, as we've split them all up and transferred them to different items. For example, the smartphone can no longer take photos and the flashlight no longer has a UV light, but this decision opens a huge door for future updates in terms of upgrades. We also have a lot more options for perks that we didn't have before. We are convinced that we will introduce a very motivating upgrade system in the near future, which will be a lot of fun and super rewarding. It is also likely that the functions will return depending on the upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4699bab0626f6d597e7e9866ee4a772429b681f4.gif[/img]

To keep the excitement high, we will let you explore the new tasks for yourself rather than describing them here. We'll just say this much: some of them require brains, others precision. There's a bit of everything and there will be even more in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/6a7b858b6f342c23c445d682f1807c010f8cf0ea.gif[/img]

With the addition of the new items, we have also added “special” loot that sits behind glass in addition to normal loot and the Black Market items. You can smash the glass to steal the randomly placed loot behind it.

[h3]Further changes and adjustments[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to see Inuva on the tablet through the cameras
[*] Dead players can now communicate with each other as ghosts
[*] Light switches now have a short cooldown to prevent desynchronization
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] Fixed a case where the speed of the entities was calculated wrong in black market missions
[*] Fixed some positions you could get stuck in
[/list]

[h3]More[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Halloween has also made it back to Midnight City, adding a spooky yet cozy atmosphere to the lobby. We are even currently working on new skins, which we also want to release very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0a29d8d10188fab2f5692f2a32cece5db6cbd4b8.jpg[/img]

We are really looking forward to your feedback!

As a small note to conclude the devlog: Our German-speaking partner streamer MadMiez will be streaming Midnight Heist on October 31, 2024 (Halloween) around 5pm [UCT], introducing the new update and giving away keys for the game. If you are interested and have time, you are cordially invited to drop by!

Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Black Market Missions
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Our biggest gameplay-changing system to date is finally ready:

[h1]The Black Market missions![/h1]

We have spent a lot of time balancing this system as much as possible and fixing bugs, of which there were quite a few, as we have added many new modifiers that greatly affect the gameplay.

[b]Let's introduce this system step by step:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0ec8c2a36e17769ef21090ef11217d493e6321a5.jpg[/img]
We have redesigned the look of the Black Market so that you can now find two categories in it. The valuables that you have already stolen in order to sell them at a daily changing rate and the new category “Missions”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/45287788f94a6d1878a37617a83bd2625f533069.jpg[/img]
This is what the user interface looks like once you have selected the missions. Lots of information, lots of numbers, some nice shiny stars and the usual skulls staring back at us. Let's go through them one by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/9f460543a44173e4416f0fa8d01bd0906f1bb216.png[/img]
Together with the Black Market Missions, we have introduced a new currency called “Data”. You need this to be able to generate Black Market Missions. Depending on the modifiers of a mission, these missions are sometimes more and sometimes less expensive to generate. You can also exchange your money for data and your data for money, depending on what you need more of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/22ce8234f27b7e8239711644cde3db93fa99bf5c.png[/img]

Here you can decide for yourself how difficult (but also rewarding) your black market mission should be. A maximum of 5 modifiers are active at the same time, one positive and one negative, and a maximum of 5 tiers that simultaneously influence the values of the positive and negative modifiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/d48b843564e2eb0a65751de684e4f65ca74305a3.png[/img]
We have rated the Black Market missions with stars. Half a star each for increasing the tier and half a star each for adding a modifier, so that you can achieve a total of 5 stars (tier 5 and 5 modifiers).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/dc1bb3688ba27c3f8efe74152879247012fc84f3.png[/img]
Once you have generated a mission, it will appear directly in your mission inventory on the left side. You can have a maximum of 32 missions. Here you can also use the mission buttons to hide or display the information, delete the mission again or equip it so that it is activated for your next heist (more on this in a moment).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f650dee74db526add866b763d6e2dfb945ec7a2a.png[/img]
In addition to generating missions, we have also added four randomly generated weekly missions that you can select for free, but beware: once a mission is activated, it disappears forever after you have completed your heist. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/965df6976c5068059c8d4657926b9421d7d20a5e.png[/img]
You can now see from the skull symbol whether you have selected a Black Market mission and if you hover over it with the mouse, you will also see the positive and negative modifiers that you will activate for the upcoming heist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0e51debd634480c53c9e10cf5174d2b0bb9de39b.png[/img]

You can also select a Black Market mission from the operator itself if you have forgotten to do so directly in the Black Market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/a4119f96296ce378d713bc5d74ccf93f50f1e00a.png[/img]
A new icon is now available on the tablet in the heists, which gives you information about the current mission and active modifiers. Just like in the menu, you can hover over the skull icon to get more information on active modifiers.

The Black Market mission system should be fine in its current state after countless tests, but we are always open to feedback and suggestions.

We won't reveal which modifiers are available apart from the shared screenshots to let you discover as much as possible for yourself, but there are quite a few to look forward to. 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] The modifier that increases the number of safes spawns one code per safe. So if there are three safes, for example, there are three codes that you can find and use.

[h3]Other[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In addition to the Black Market system, we have implemented your previous feedback and extended the time between hunts on all difficulty levels so that you are not constantly being hunted (especially on higher difficulty levels).

We have also changed the font of the safecode for better readability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/6ce6b0a0c8e3402ca8406b33d86ad077f79280fc.png[/img]

In addition to this update, we have also improved the netcode so that we can expect a more stable connection and have reduced possible errors.

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
After this update, we will now focus on the major gameplay changes that will bring new tasks and make Midnight Heist much more replayable. We want to have a major update ready by Halloween, which will also bring other smaller changes such as new skins, new mini-games and ongoing adjustments to existing systems.

Since the Black Market mission system turned out to be more difficult and extensive than we thought, we would like to point out that even after endless testing, bugs are still to be expected. You can send them to us as usual and we will take care of them as soon as possible.

[hr][/hr]

Until then, see you in Midnight City

notes.title: Modules, New Entities & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We've brought big changes and improvements with this update that not only adds new entities, but also a brand new system to improve your character and an overhaul of how electricity works. Let's start with the new system!

[h3]Modules[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/6fd84f99e3f8765ef3753ec2d8adddeb308b2df8.jpg[/img]
Modules are equippable, passive items that improve your character with various properties. You can obtain these modules at random from a 3D printer in exchange for money in your hideout. At the moment, it costs 2.500 to build a module, but you can sell it again at any time. The value of a module is determined by its rarity. A maximum of 32 modules can be stored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/01ee1df7deb8d9d86d2541ac89a0b9adef7c5aad.gif[/img]

The rarity and possible bonuses are randomly selected. You can get modules in the rarities Normal, Rare and Epic. The rarity determines the number of available bonuses. There are a total of 3 module slots, which differ in the categories: Agility, Senses and Finance. Each category offers its own strengths and allows for a wide range of possible combinations of improvements.


[b]Overview of module improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Normal modules have one bonus
[*] Rare modules have two bonuses
[*] Epic modules have three bonuses
[/list]

[b]Agility[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8871afb5706fc579a894b2e50ef6e58ac16167f6.png[/img]

Possible bonuses:
[list]
[*] + X% more stamina
[*] + X% faster sprint
[*] + X% faster movement when walking
[*] + X% quieter movement
[*] + X% faster stamina recovery
[*] Removes the stamina recharge delay
[/list]
[b]Sense[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0b8c2e2f5d4a60d0e8141eb03baa00dc0b7203b3.png[/img]

Possible bonuses:
[list]
[*] + X% enhanced vision in the dark
[*] + X% larger radius of the hacking signal
[*] + X% larger lockpick range
[*] + X% faster hacking speed
[*] + X% increased field of vision for Black Market items
[*] + X% chance to warn you when an entity appears
[/list]
[b]Finance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/545e60f82489cd84fe8e15b81835f00ca198c9a3.png[/img]

Possible bonuses:
[list]
[*] + X% higher chance that a Black Market item is rarer
[*] + X% chance of double value when collecting loot
[*] + X% more loot value when collecting electronics
[*] + X% more loot value when collecting Documents
[*] + X% more loot value when collecting cash
[*] + X% more data when hacking
[*] + X% chance of getting double the amount of data
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/e397807a790d5d8e8f8224b2819f4c894ebdf631.jpg[/img]

The maximum rolled out values are each given a star. So if you want to look out for really strong modules, hunt for epic three-star variants, which are incredibly rare!

The modules give you the opportunity to customize your character even further, which actually has an effect on the gameplay. With the modules comes the first really "meaningful" opportunity to spend money to get better.

[h3]New entities[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We've added two new, challenging entities that can appear at any time during your heists: Ragnok and Inuva.

[b]Ragnok[/b]
Ragnok is a large and powerful entity that shakes the ground with its presence alone. It is slower than other entities, but all the more dangerous if you get too close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/59ba7a6fa36693812c4827dc6223020c26fd1779.gif[/img]

[b]Inuva[/b]
Inuva is the exact opposite of Ragnok and hides its presence so that it is barely visible. Only a trained eye and a UV light source can spot it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/ae666317b4ff04ae2187f0c42f2f14a4b403e7de.gif[/img]

[h3]Overhaul of electricity[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Previously, an activated light source consumed one of five electricity points. If you exceed this limit, you experience a power failure and have to go to the fuse box to restore the power.

Now, various actions use electricity. Hacking computers in particular now also actively consumes power:
[list]
[*] Active light source = 15% electricity
[*] Hacking computer = 5% electricity
[*] Hacking laptops = no power consumption (connected to battery)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/ff1c4bcbe789de70c679f9ba5bbb4e86403b59e7.png[/img]

Depending on the level of difficulty, there is also a chance that you will start without power:
[list]
[*] Easy: No chance to start without power
[*] Normal: Chance of 5%
[*] Hard: Chance of 20%
[*] Nightmare: Chance of 50%
[/list]
With this overhaul of electricity, we want to make the gameplay more dynamic. In addition, it is also planned that in future you will lose less Sanity when standing in the light to give the electricity even more meaning.

[h3]Further changes and adjustments[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] New option to set the maximum FPS (only works with vsync off)
[*] New option for setting the FOV (Field of View)
[*] New entity event that switches off the electricity
[*] The cooldown time between entity hunts on higher difficulty has been increased
[*] It is now possible to collect more than 100% data
[*] Collected data also corresponds to XP. It is therefore now possible to level up faster/better
[*] As a ghost, you now have unlimited stamina
[*] Updated the splash screen
[*] If the connection is lost due to an error, you are now sent to the main menu and receive a pop-up message that can help us solve errors
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Perks[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
These perks require a certain level to be unlocked and can be leveled up once they are equipped. Each perk can be upgraded to a maximum of level 3 and unlocks further or better advantages with each new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/050dd2fa6ede6fe93ac2ea7b49e8c3186e8e0b09.jpg[/img]
A maximum of 3 perks can be equipped at the same time. Each of these will be credited with 10% of your heist XP after each heist. There is also a maximum limit for some perks, as these are considered "team buffs" and we have paid particular attention to fairness for solo and group players. For example, there can be three players using a level 1 perk or just one player using a level 3 perk. It has the same effect and solo players are not disadvantaged.

In addition, we have added a workbench computer with this update, which will give you access to your perks and even more ways to improve your character in the future. Over time, more perks will be added that will change the way you play even more.

notes.title: New Entities, New Map & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

First of all, we would like to thank each and every one of you for all the detailed and fantastic feedback. You have a lot of ideas and suggestions on how to make Midnight Heist better and all of this feedback will be incorporated into our roadmap as we work with you to create the next level of co-op horror games.

With this first major content update, we focused on the behavior, appearance and animations of the entity. In addition, we created a new medium sized map and made QoL (Quality of Life) changes. We also added some small helpful features. Here is the update in detail:

[h3]New medium large map:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
For the solo players of you, the large maps have been a little tiring as they are really big and by the time the last computer has been hacked, you have explored the building once completely. With this new map of a failed startup, we offer a more compact level design with a completely different atmosphere and sometimes narrow corridors that can put you in a tight spot in critical situations if you're not careful. The interior design has also been adapted accordingly, so that in some cases very old computers have to be hacked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/20482950d441e6a9df5aa9310bba57b4f39e72e3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/3b691e60acbd80dc50a4e11886c520f00c86a4c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/5f822b64381a1a29a08107771dd69dbde4dfa7da.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/aa4c40067c82ba2061f4fcb205f2cd3e24444510.png[/img]

[h3]Improved entities behaviour[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have completely redesigned and massively improved the behavior, appearance and animations of the entities from the ground up. Not only do they now look more realistic and creepy, they also behave differently. The sounds of the entities have also been improved and reworked.

[b]The view[/b], i.e. the way entities see something, has also been massively revised. If you position yourself cleverly, you cannot be seen behind a desk with a monitor on it, as the desk covers the body and the monitor the head.

[b]The entity spawn system[/b] has also been revised. The entities now always spawn as far away as possible and produce a very bass-heavy sound over a long distance when they spawn, so that you may be warned when it is there.

[b]Improved sound system with sound occlusion[/b]
Many people have noticed that you can hear the Entity very clearly when it is above or below you, i.e. on a different floor. The flickering of the flashlight and the heartbeat were also triggered when the Entity was at a different height. With the new sound occlusion system, we have not only solved the problem, but drastically improved the atmosphere. Now you can hear the Entities' footsteps and screams muffled when they are behind walls or on a different floor.

In addition, all Entities now have a boost in the form of a 10% higher movement speed when the power goes out. Be careful when the light goes out!

[h3]Two new entities[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Furthermore, we have added two more entities that are very different in appearance and behavior to the previous entity. The three are now called: Karma, Nishi and Goryo. You can find out more about them and their behavior in the in-game guide on the tablet. But here is a brief overview:

[b]Karma[/b] (previous entity)
An entity that can see and hear equally well. It has no special features, but is all the more a terrific all-rounder in the basic abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/62eb0c64f9c2e8964243ae2584cfe042104fc8e5.png[/img]

[b]Nishi[/b]
An Entity that can see extremely poorly but hear incredibly well. It probably sees less than your grandmother without glasses, but can hear over long distances and has the special ability to sprint quickly towards a noise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4a2011a6dfd1a536c474b4eb61f5988ca46ad120.png[/img]

[b]Goryo[/b]
An Entity that is deaf, but can see very well due to its two-headed stature and extra pair of eyes. Has a great range of vision, but hears absolutely nothing. It has the special ability to sense hacking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/56a902ae1a0bdb5c6bb82838b25d00e0e7a257fa.jpg[/img]

[h3]Two new hacking tasks[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We've added two more hacking tasks to add a little more variety. More tasks will be added with further updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4a0e6bab08d01fe1413fe45544f41e4c2451f0c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0a7caafec494e86ed092d8dbffe90b0ecc791738.jpg[/img]

[h3]Zoom function[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have implemented a zoom function that allows you to improve your view a little. Especially in the situation to read the code for the safe, some had difficulties, which are now eliminated with this function. Also useful for strange shadows that you see in the distance and want to zoom in to make sure what was just there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/18578dba225c114b3a6043252726ad0512c345fb.gif[/img]

[h3]Overview of the security cameras[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have added an overview of the available and already hacked cameras in the mission details (hold tab), which relate to the entire building. Another new feature is the display of the floor on which the hacked camera you are currently looking through is located. Thanks again for your feedback!

[h3]Other[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Added sneak toggle option[/b]
We have received numerous requests to make sneaking toggleable instead of always having to hold down the button to sneak. This is exactly what we have implemented!

[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the light reflection was not updated during a power outage
- Player ghosts can no longer climb on tables

[h3]What next?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We'll be tackling the gameplay next by adding special selectable abilities/perks to make the player more powerful and adding more tasks to get more variation in the game rounds. You can find out what exactly is still to come in our roadmap. Feel free to send us feedback, ideas and suggestions at any time. If you haven't hopped on our Discord server yet, you can find the invitation here:

Feel free to write us an honest review here on Steam and tell us what you think of Midnight Heist!

Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Roadmap & October Devlog
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Early Access[/h1]

Hello everyone! We thank you very much for your numerous and detailed feedback so far and we are glad how much fun you have with Midnight Heist! 


[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We still have a lot of ideas for the future of Midnight Heist. Our biggest priority will be to continue developing the game, adding new content and constantly improving the gameplay experience. With this roadmap we share our ideas with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/35458d9436b33b1b2f21cf834cf51f736278504f.png[/img]

Depending on the active players, there will be content coming your way beyond that. Your feedback and ideas are crucial to the journey of Midnight Heist!


[h2]New features and changes after the demo[/h2]

[h3]Two new player models[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In the demo you have been able to play Darryl and Elija, the two men in the team of the four-member hacker gang. We have added Kate and Luxury, the two women of the team. Say hello to them when you see them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/1db9bec6fe611c52423035ccf15252011d588291.png[/img]

[h3]The store and the wardrobe[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have implemented a store where you can buy clothes for your character with the earned money. These include: Head, upper body, gloves, lower body and shoes. Additionally, you can buy cosmetic customizations for your equipment! These include the flashlight, smartphone, and tablet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/377dc4d9ded76e34acdfb058073041c6a113ae8c.png[/img]

With the launch of Early Access, we released the "Early Bird Collection", which has over 80+ cosmetic items for you to unlock. In total, there is even a little more that you can unlock through special missions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/be9b9de7b9459b9eeb80bc943577c59556a62dfe.jpg[/img]

Each character can be individually customized. Some clothing is limited to certain characters, though we may remove this limitation in the future. (This limitation is due to the technical nature of the game).

[h3]A new map[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
At the start of Early Access two maps are available: CemaX Agency North and CemaX Agency South. They are identical in theme, but completely different in layout, so you have some variety. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/7c6d49c47f89ba4082bb28479c07e8023b884e75.jpg[/img]

New maps will follow soon, with new themes and new gameplay possibilities in store for you!

[h3]The operations[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The operations are special challenges that provide you with big rewards and major story contents. They are dedicated to the three organizations in Midnight City, for which you have to fulfill certain tasks. Don't mess with them though, they can be very unforgiving and are extremely good at tracking down traitors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/7c75ac8e4f3202de7011dc2cf60febd0a57fd781.jpg[/img]

This content explains the happenings in Midnight City and goes deeper into the details. Among them are the mysterious entities and a secret organization called P.E.G.A.S.U.S.

Operations can be considered as episodes. Over time, we will release more operations that will come back with their own story content and rewards, so you are actively a part of the story in Midnight City!

notes.title: August / July Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
A lot has happened since the last devlog and we have a lot of new content to present! We are more ambitious than ever and are super thankful for the feedback we get with the constantly updated demo. Here's what we've been working on:

[h3]Less computers and tasks[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We decided to have fewer computers spawning so that you are also forced to explore the building a bit instead of running from desk to desk. Fewer computers are also needed to complete the mission. To make hacking more interesting at the same time and not so monotonous, we have added tasks. There will be more tasks as development progresses. With these changes, the gameplay feels more complete than it was before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0fb4533f3bb46551eb8dcc9b85fc90e382089281.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/15d43abef3d70dbc75428c421758a20e01005567.jpg[/img]

[h3]Level System[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
To improve the long-term gameplay of Midnight Heist and to represent personal experience, we have included a level system that will also be encountered after each mission played. Depending on your success or failure, you will collect experience points and level up. Your deeds will reflect how much experience you get. In the future, there may be more content related to the leveling system, such as skill points that you can distribute to get special bonuses. Feel free to send us your ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/5f4d7e87e990b1b7cdb148501c25a325808b42e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/5f7eea56ce7f0a5978880f3093704647ff72c99c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Black Market[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The Black Market is an app on your computer in the Hideout that you can use between heists. In the Black Market you will have access to your special Black Market items that you have stolen in the missions. The special thing here is that the value of the items changes every (real) day. These values can vary greatly from up to -25% or even up to +75% and can be viewed directly using the history. It is up to you whether you want to wait for the right price or sell the things directly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/52c66ba034b5e296d4d21113b28bc994f0c0322f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/266e87b6fd9e3032afb854bd1c7ded1d7665116a.jpg[/img]

[h3]New hacker gadget and cameras[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have added a new tool for you hackers and thieves - The Tablet! With this tablet you will get access to hacked cameras, which can be found on every floor in the office buildings. You can hack the cameras with your smartphone and then get a view of them with the tablet. You can also zoom in and change cameras if you have hacked more than one. The quality of the video from the cameras is not the best, but you will be able to recognize power sources and "unusual things" very quickly. The tablet will also get a guide with tips and tricks in the near future, which you can always access in the game if you feel lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/764dc16cfa61c48f4a96101f78d98e974ec4b067.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8dd2b5b93e10bba197b192a3f8e8a39066483fbc.jpg[/img]

[h3]New UV light for the flashlight and safes[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We've given the flashlight a very special UV light that allows you to find codes on left behind notes hidden somewhere in the building. These codes lead to a safe that contains more loot than usual. Sometimes you can even find very unusual, suspicious traces with the UV light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/9c84db7f8afadc548a1aff423fd8e724fe1adf6b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/775939ba2c69dff221c6615c53e4050e17fbd22c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0c28c16a61cd6dab5b55a99ff13c418c8ca86e39.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/a045f1b2e1481d5876f0d47d547f3b1b065472d3.jpg[/img]

[h3]New horror and more events[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We've added a lot of new sounds and events to make the game even more fun. Also your environment will now want to interact with you, for example by throwing small objects around. Special events are also available, but to keep them special, we'll let you figure them out for yourself! We also changed the look of the ghost to make it look more ghosty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/87032d2f0659cf1713e4cb77c52286cfcdb0ca7d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/63ab8d1f283322b06379684f7d3c5a52dc7f443b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Locked doors inside buildings[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
To make being a thief a bit more realistic and difficult, we have provided a small number of rooms inside the building with classic or electronic locks. So you always have to be careful which door you can use at the moment without ending up in a dead end e.g. during an escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4c441c0d5cdce3aede07b11392d75d29c3ed2600.jpg[/img]

[h3]Release and further content[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We are looking to release Midnight Heist towards the end of October. We are more than satisfied with the base components and have even added more unplanned content on top, which only developed through the ideas of you, our community. Now we are focusing on the multiplayer aspect, which will be followed by the operations, the store and other side tasks as well as challenges. This will be far from everything we have planned for Midnight Heist, but once these things are through in development, we are ready to send Midnight Heist into Early Access and work on more content.

We hope we could give you another good insight into the development of Midnight Heist with this devlog. As always, feel free to send us feedback and ideas!


Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: June Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

First of all, we would like to thank the players of the Midnight Heist demo and the feedback it has received. The demo is only a small fraction of what you can expect in the full game. We take every comment, idea, and constructive criticism into consideration in order to constantly improve. In this devlog, we'll go over changes we've been working on up until the demo and will continue to work on.

[h3]Side tasks[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In Midnight Heist, the main objective is to hack various devices in order to steal data from them that is relevant to the client. This is the only requirement to successfully complete a heist. However, we have included side tasks to make each heist more interesting. Each company hides illegal activities, from which you can take pictures to get extra rewards. Each illegal activity is different, but in the near future it will be recognized by your smartphone, so you will be able to identify it more easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f1f9bef58dfb50fff48ae711ae9a650c8dbc3bd2.png[/img]

In addition to normal loot like electronic valuables, important documents, or cash, each heist will also include one or more announced "rare valuable" for you to steal. This will be shared throughout the team so that everyone gets some. Afterwards, you can sell these special valuables in the black market on your hideout's computer, but beware: the black market has a different demand all the time, so the price can fluctuate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/1fa1ae4846f7a1acb36ea6ad27c2e4cb2d3911b9.png[/img]

Furthermore, numerous other side tasks are planned to make each heist even more exciting. Again, your feedback will be very important, feel free to send us your ideas.

[h3]Horror elements and dangers[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In each heist you will be able to find lockers and bathrooms where you can hide from danger. However, there are other methods to avoid the dangers. The player's movements create noise, the more you move and especially the faster you move, the louder you are. On the other hand, if you sneak, you don't create noise and you won't be found as quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/e004130cf9c4bf0a3a2a1fee7ede6a0ddcaf3f0e.gif[/img]

We are still planning a big new change in this regard: in the future it will be possible to be protected once in the light. If there is electricity and you stand in the light while the danger is attacking the player, the light will be destroyed and the player will be protected. But beware, the danger is by no means stupid.

[h3]Unlocking doors[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Some doors in Midnight Heist are specially protected. There are the electronically protected doors and the mechanically protected doors. The electronic ones can be hacked by holding the smartphone to the keypad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/82a8f66bb6f12e2d1f11beb071d4523f29ba6ca8.png[/img]

The mechanically protected doors, on the other hand, have to be unlocked with some skill. Classically, with a screwdriver and a lockpick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/5769ad3ab368dd6b8cad8a979c01e02ce8e595af.png[/img]

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We have introduced a tutorial level that explains to new players how things work. This level will be constantly updated with upcoming changes so that all mechanics in the game are explained. We strongly recommend to play this level at least once

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/4c8aad07c9123a5aa954df866e86c951e4b655c6.png[/img]

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The menu has received major changes in appearance and functionality. While we can't show everything yet, here are some impressions from the demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/77bc1220a1d79984d9cfe2faf5904d96f2761ad0.png[/img]

[h3]Controls and controller support[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Midnight Heist has got full controller support, as well as the possibility to remap all buttons. With this we want to offer as much flexibility as possible and new ways of playing that you didn't have before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/eecdd37c8c3c724b8110da3b582c26da1bf049fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/20335aa77a14e5e1a78c3937908d565bf46826dd.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
These are the latest news from the development of Midnight Heist. You can always ask us questions about the game or submit ideas and suggestions. Either here in the Steam discussions, on Twitter, via Instagram or via email. We hope you enjoyed this devlog, there's a lot more to come!

Until then, see you in Midnight City
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: April Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

In this devlog we go over the current development of Midnight Heist, planned features, and a timeframe for a playable demo!

[h3]Hideout Computer[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The computer in the hideout serves as an operations center to launch missions. We have extensively reworked this and made the interface simpler and more appropriate to fit the theme of the game. Each player will have a computer in his hideout to connect with other players. However, it can also do a lot more and there will be a lot more features added over time. In the emails, you will receive jobs from large organizations, which will earn you reputation points and larger rewards for completing them. There are also a lot of statistics to constantly monitor your game progress and compare it with others. Currently, we are also planning to introduce a black market, where you can sell valuables that constantly fluctuate in price and demand. These valuables can be found during heists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/1926e395712d6301faf0825651dddf1501d1c301.gif[/img]

[h3]Power and Light[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
During heists in the companies, monitoring of electricity usage will be available. To avoid drawing too much attention, this will be greatly reduced for your own protection. It will be possible to turn on lights in various rooms, with the risk of being exposed to greater danger. If more lights are turned on than the power limit allows, the automatic security system will create a blackout, so the power will have to be restored. We are also planning more fun ways to be able to use the electricity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f1efa0b80c84803f277e3d41e8ecfa0f54cbc698.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/b79eb5e538770cf6f395756d5ebd28206de22fdc.png[/img]

[h3]Horror and AI[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
To keep the horror factor as high as possible, we're adding a large amount of visual and audio elements that constantly change and provide ever-changing experiences in each round. The ghost will be able to hear and see you, so you'll always have to be careful, as well as sneaky to avoid making too much noise. You'll also be able to hide in closets and behind objects, but the AI can interact with them if it wants to. In order to introduce as much dynamics as possible, the AI will minimally adapt its abilities in each round. Thus, it remains relatively unpredictable, but can be studied with patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/e89fa05551dcd8214291e5200fc2ace6d1adb726.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/ad2402a3d63bcac639156945c7a62879d5af8e6e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/5c790e3ae7fad3d99488339963c12699a10eed45.gif[/img]

[h3]UI Elements[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We want the experience of Midnight Heist to be very visually appealing, so there are animations and custom UI elements for most interactions and things to elevate the game experience. You get feedback for a lot of things that accompany the gameplay experience, taking the player by the hand with it to better immerse themselves in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/f7fa2dc43e4cba339bacec953efff9a0504617f7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/8d0218b105694c5eda45ab55ce9c921137c200ea.gif[/img]

[h3]Midnight Heist Demo[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Steam Next Fest will take place again in June 2023, where numerous developers will showcase their upcoming titles and promote them using a playable demo. We also want to participate in the Next Fest and therefore plan to present a playable demo of Midnight Heist. However, it is not yet clear whether this demo will be playable in singleplayer or in multiplayer. The basic functions are already there and work solidly, but there are still a lot of features to be added and for this reason we have to see which of them will make it into the demo and which will not. The demo will be very important for us to gather feedback.

There are some very interesting things coming up. We will keep you up to date, until the next devlog!

Until then,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: March Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Welcome to the very first devlog of Midnight Heist, our upcoming co-op horror game where you work alone or together as a relatively inexperienced hacker to complete tasks for organizations by sneaking into companies and stealing their data. Just like our previous title Psych, you can expect behind-the-scenes insights, exclusive sneak peeks, and of course discussions with the community about content we're developing in these irregular devlogs so we can always incorporate and consider your feedback. We will keep our development the same as with Psych and always keep your opinions in the foreground, as well as let your ideas inspire us. Now let's get started!

[h3]Improvements in our technology and way of working[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you do not know how and with what we work. We mainly use the Unity Engine, Blender, Substance Painter and various other tools to create games. The biggest bummer with Psych was that we were using an old, in beta, so-called "HDRP" (High Definition Render Pipeline). Because of the HDRP, lights and shadows looked more realistic, however, the version was so broken that we gradually got more and more bugs that we couldn't fix. Porting to another version didn't work either, because that led to more bugs and we didn't want to start from scratch. That's why at Midnight Heist we start with a brand new version of Unity, which supports our work with rich features and stable functionality. Not only does this give us less headaches, but it also has a positive impact on development in the long run. After all the work of Psych, we have learned a lot. Often only thanks to you, our community.

[h3]The idea for Midnight Heist[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
We already knew during the development of Psych that we wanted to create a multiplayer game as our next project. There are many colleagues who have released good games, so we were even more inspired to create something new and fresh. It should also be horror, but related to hackers and thieves who have to complete tasks for organizations to increase their reputation and build up their own hideout. Just something that should also motivate in the long run. We also plan to have a character customization reward system, entirely without season passes or other monetized methods, to deliver you an honest "buy only once to enjoy" experience. The BIGGEST aspect is on gameplay and exploration. We want to deliver a great subliminal story that can be followed, but doesn't have to be. With that, we want to cover as many players as possible. Those who love story and the story behind games and those who just play for fun. Midnight Heist is meant to be easy to understand, but with difficulty levels you can choose how challenging you want the game to be.

[h3]New challenges[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Since Midnight Heist will be our first online game, there was also a big learning curve around network technology this time. We have already successfully completed most of it, but are constantly working on improvements. With the idea of being able to customize the character, as well as the hideout, we are adding new features that we have never done before. Your feedback will definitely be important here to help us with the development. Another big challenge will be the AI from the threat (No spoilers!). The idea is to be able to let the player hide or run away when the threat approaches. However, the AI is supposed to be intelligent enough that it will also notice something is wrong during the course of the game round and take a closer look. For example, you can hide in the closet once or maybe twice, but the AI would open the closet at the latest the third time to take a closer look - that's the idea.

[h3]Hacking[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
In order to fulfill the mission and satisfy your employers, the large organizations, you'll have to steal data. With your Smartphone with the latest Hack OS, you will get access to various tools that will only enable you to hack the electronic devices of the companies. In order to hack a device, you will have to connect to it through your Smartphone. Once access to the electronic device is gained, the data transfer process will start. The closer you are to the device to be hacked, the faster it will proceed. If the hack is successful, the transferred data will be stored on your phone and the hacked device will be locked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/3cf1553aac073ab724cbb10cc47e60caab64451f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/0ecba56bc75cf07aa24cc5e59cb5cef7366beca4.png[/img]

[h3]Looting[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As hackers and thieves, loot will be of great importance to you. You can loot not only digital data of the companies, but also physical valuables such as important documents, jewelry, cash and so on. There are numerous cabinets and drawers that you can open and search. There is always something different hiding behind each one. Also, there will be sections in companies that are especially protected. These are difficult to reach, but contain especially valuable valuables. The loot that you acquire can be exchanged for cryptocurrencies, which you can use to expand your hideout, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/266e15016d2bed9e5f55c4b64aa1be6776c7e896.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/32d1a0bf12322c58135f66e1ccfa35a851cc5301.png[/img]

[h3]Companies[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Each map in Midnight Heist will represent a company in some way. We have already completed the first map. A large company with three floors called Cemax Agency, where you can hack more than 40 electronic devices such as computers and laptops, to steal their data. We'll also have variations of companies, as well as secrets such as locked rooms that you can only open with certain items. Basically, each map will have its own challenges. Here you can see a few glimpses of the Cemax Agency:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/002ae0f2334f02b224f92b2a9230cf744a07e31e.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/ed7f1488d4933b62ebad8e4e6194520126f07ecb.png[/img]


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/aef051338f4479db499a081b64b3ff4f197a70bc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/bfb33cf2fd35fa632f182efd2c6becb2d8ad9b13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/65a449e97340c609240e31712fd1ebba820da594.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/35b546d55d7287e0b3694a8ef1eafb74d626b9a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483122/312ca5ed6962d3c5914be80285b198857b78115a.png[/img]

[h3]The current state[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Yes, we would also like to be ready and play right away, but unfortunately we are not there yet. Thanks to Psych we were able to adopt some scripts and models, but we have to and especially want to do a lot of things better and take our time to make things good. We can't give you a release date yet, but we promise that it won't take more than a few months. We're pretty far along, but we still have to tie all the systems together and test, test, test. We will keep you updated and share upcoming features and ideas with you!

We hope to have picked you up with this first devlog and are already looking forward to the next one!
Feel free to write us your opinions and ideas, we are looking forward to it.

Until then,
Dan and Andreas
